title: Spec: AppDataDictionary extensions in UpdateRoomResponse, UpdateRequest, KeyMaterialRequest and each ClientKeyMaterial
description: Draft PR to ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol for #190: add an extensions field (AppDataDictionary, like consent_extensions and id_request_extensions) to UpdateRoomResponse, UpdateRequest, KeyMaterialRequest and ClientKeyMaterial in protocol-07 §5.2/§5.3. Say a receiver MUST ignore entries it does not know. Mention IETF 127 interop table origin. Posting needs Mark's OK.
